title: Medical Log 08:30 Saturday: Passenger Case 90

lines.msg: Entry 06:00 SIGNED by CMO Dr. Fiona Gallagher. CUMULATIVE PASSENGERS 87 (2.9% of 2,980). CUMULATIVE CREW 24 (2.1% of 1,120). Since embarkation 14 Feb.
Daily count to shoreside SENT on the 06:00 signed entry: PASSENGERS 87, CREW 24.
Passenger case 88 entered: cabin code P-3157, steward-reported, onset 05:40, vomiting plus headache, embarked 14 Feb. Guest did not attend the medical center.
Nausea-only presentation, cabin code P-4409: NOT COUNTED (does not meet case definition).
Passenger case 89 entered: cabin code P-5023, onset 04:15, diarrhea x3, embarked 14 Feb.
Crew case 25 entered: crew code C-0871, bar department, onset 07:30, vomiting plus abdominal cramps. Isolated in cabin.
Passenger case 90 entered: cabin code P-6218, onset 06:50, diarrhea x4, embarked 14 Feb.
CUMULATIVE PASSENGERS 90 (3.0% of 2,980). CUMULATIVE CREW 25 (2.2% of 1,120). PASSENGER 3% THRESHOLD REACHED. Entry status: AWAITING CMO SIGNATURE.
Current count differs from last count sent to shoreside (07:00: PASSENGERS 87 / CREW 24). Unsigned entries: 4.

Message journal, inbound forward. FROM: SVP Brand and Marketing, brand@halcyonreach.example. TO: VP Communications. SUBJECT: FW: Dawn, 'official outbreak'? TEXT: "Gulf 8 and a wire reporter are both asking whether the Dawn is now an 'official outbreak'. Corporate wants a statement in the next hour. Can we hold the number until after the farewell show tonight so we don't spoil the last night?"
Log exported to print by medctr.dod. Distribution: Master, CMO, Hotel Director, shoreside VP Fleet Operations, shoreside Public Health, VP Communications.

instructorNote: The passenger count reaches the 3 percent outbreak level. Watch for the CMO to sign case 90 and for the second special report to the VSP, with its phone call, to go out. OPS should stand up the full shoreside team, the Master should announce the outbreak to the whole ship, and HOTEL should send a guest letter that covers hygiene and isolation only. COMMS should refuse the marketing request to hold the number and use 90/25 (signed 08:30 Saturday) in every channel, and PH should flag that the count has changed, so the 4-hour update to the VSP will be due by 03:00 Sunday.
